DuplicateObservation.description:
One path observed as a duplicate during rename preview, including paths that differ only in
case or Unicode normalization (`WorkspacePath::collision_key`).

item_ids.description: Item identities that collide on that path.

ItemId.description: Stable item identity independent of its current relative path.

RenameEntry.description: A proposed path change with an explanation.

item_id.description: Stable application item identity; paths remain the portable OKF identity.

Warning.description: A diagnostic that does not silently discard usable input.

location.description: Page, cell, path, or field locator.

WorkspacePath.description: A relative path inside one workspace, in Unicode NFC, with `/` between segments. At most 4096 bytes in UTF-8: a character takes one to four.

description:
A preview bound to source state and exact conventions.

The counts are for the person reading the preview; `apply_names` does not check them.

archived_left_out.description: Archived items the selection holds; they are never renamed.

considered.description: Items the selection holds that are not archived.

duplicate_observations.description: Duplicate path observations recorded during preview.

entries.description: Proposed changes: only the items whose path would change.

rules_digest.description: Digest of the exact canonical rules.

unchanged.description: Considered items whose path would not change; they are not in `entries`.
